<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="3" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="4L--KoEELn88crYMqGhs"> <mxGraphModel dx="1896" dy="851" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Class Diagram - Domain Model (BrewLite)

skinparam backgroundColor White
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundCorner 0
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam classFontStyle bold
skinparam classAttributeFontStyle plain
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam nodesep 60
skinparam ranksep 60

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor Black
 BorderThickness 1.2
 FontStyle bold
 ArrowColor Black
 FontColor Black
 AttributeFontColor Black
 StereotypeFontColor Black
 StereotypeFontSize 11
}
skinparam stereotypeCBackgroundColor White
hide circle
hide empty members

class OrderStatus <<enumeration>> #E3F4F4 {
 PENDING
 PAID
 PAYMENT_FAILED
 PREPARING
 READY
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
}

class PaymentMethod <<enumeration>> #E3F4F4 {
 WALLET
 CARD
}

class PaymentStatus <<enumeration>> #E3F4F4 {
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
}

class Product {
 + String id
 + String name
 + Decimal price
 + String imageUrl
 + Integer stock
 --
 + findAll()
 + findOne(id: String)
}

class OrderItem {
 + String id
 + String orderId
 + String productId
 + String size
 + String topping
 + Integer qty
 + Decimal lineTotal
 --
 + calculateLineTotal(basePrice: Decimal, size: OrderSize, toppings: String[], quantity: Integer): Decimal
}

class Promotion {
 + String id
 + String code
 + String description
 + Decimal discountPercent
 + Boolean isActive
}

class Order {
 + String id
 + String userId
 + OrderStatus status
 + Decimal total
 + String promotionCode
 + DateTime createdAt
 --
 + create(userId: String, items: CreateOrderItemDto[])
 + findMine(userId: String)
 + findOne(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + retryPayment(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + cancel(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + calculateTotal(): Decimal
 + changeStatus(from: OrderStatus, to: OrderStatus)
}

class User {
 + String id
 + String email
 + String passwordHash
 + Integer loyaltyPoints
 --
 + register(dto: RegisterDto)
 + login(dto: LoginDto)
 + getProfile(userId: String)
}

class Payment {
 + String id
 + String orderId
 + String idempotencyKey
 + Decimal amount
 + PaymentMethod method
 + PaymentStatus status
 --
 + create(userId: String, idempotencyKey: String, dto: CreatePaymentDto)
 + getOrderPaymentStatus(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + pay(dto: PayGatewayDto)
}

class LoyaltyTransaction {
 + String id
 + String userId
 + String orderId
 + Integer pointsDelta
 + DateTime createdAt
}

Product \"1\" -right- \"0..*\" OrderItem : referenced by ▶
Promotion \"0..1\" .right.> \"0..*\" Order : applied to ▶
Order \"1\" *-up- \"1..*\" OrderItem : contains ▼
Order \"1\" .right.> OrderStatus : <<use>>\nstatus
User \"1\" -right- \"0..*\" Order : places ▶
Order \"1\" .right.> \"0..*\" Payment : payment attempts ▶
Payment .right.> PaymentMethod : <<use>>\nmethod
Payment .down.> PaymentStatus : <<use>>\nstatus
Order \"1\" -down- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : related to ▶
User \"1\" -down- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : owns ▼

note bottom of Promotion
 Khai báo trong schema, chưa hiện thực hành vi (out-of-scope).
end note
note bottom of LoyaltyTransaction
 Khai báo trong schema, chưa hiện thực hành vi (out-of-scope).
end note

plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
title Class Diagram - Domain Model (BrewLite)

skinparam backgroundColor White
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam roundCorner 0
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam classFontStyle bold
skinparam classAttributeFontStyle plain
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam nodesep 60
skinparam ranksep 60

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor Black
 BorderThickness 1.2
 FontStyle bold
 ArrowColor Black
 FontColor Black
 AttributeFontColor Black
 StereotypeFontColor Black
 StereotypeFontSize 11
}
skinparam stereotypeCBackgroundColor White
hide circle
hide empty members

class OrderStatus <<enumeration>> #E3F4F4 {
 PENDING
 PAID
 PAYMENT_FAILED
 PREPARING
 READY
 COMPLETED
 CANCELLED
}

class PaymentMethod <<enumeration>> #E3F4F4 {
 WALLET
 CARD
}

class PaymentStatus <<enumeration>> #E3F4F4 {
 SUCCESS
 FAILED
}

class Product {
 + String id
 + String name
 + Decimal price
 + String imageUrl
 + Integer stock
 --
 + findAll()
 + findOne(id: String)
}

class OrderItem {
 + String id
 + String orderId
 + String productId
 + String size
 + String topping
 + Integer qty
 + Decimal lineTotal
 --
 + calculateLineTotal(basePrice: Decimal, size: OrderSize, toppings: String[], quantity: Integer): Decimal
}

class Promotion {
 + String id
 + String code
 + String description
 + Decimal discountPercent
 + Boolean isActive
}

class Order {
 + String id
 + String userId
 + OrderStatus status
 + Decimal total
 + String promotionCode
 + DateTime createdAt
 --
 + create(userId: String, items: CreateOrderItemDto[])
 + findMine(userId: String)
 + findOne(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + retryPayment(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + cancel(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + calculateTotal(): Decimal
 + changeStatus(from: OrderStatus, to: OrderStatus)
}

class User {
 + String id
 + String email
 + String passwordHash
 + Integer loyaltyPoints
 --
 + register(dto: RegisterDto)
 + login(dto: LoginDto)
 + getProfile(userId: String)
}

class Payment {
 + String id
 + String orderId
 + String idempotencyKey
 + Decimal amount
 + PaymentMethod method
 + PaymentStatus status
 --
 + create(userId: String, idempotencyKey: String, dto: CreatePaymentDto)
 + getOrderPaymentStatus(userId: String, orderId: String)
 + pay(dto: PayGatewayDto)
}

class LoyaltyTransaction {
 + String id
 + String userId
 + String orderId
 + Integer pointsDelta
 + DateTime createdAt
}

Product \"1\" -right- \"0..*\" OrderItem : referenced by ▶
Promotion \"0..1\" .right.> \"0..*\" Order : applied to ▶
Order \"1\" *-up- \"1..*\" OrderItem : contains ▼
Order \"1\" .right.> OrderStatus : <<use>>\nstatus
User \"1\" -right- \"0..*\" Order : places ▶
Order \"1\" .right.> \"0..*\" Payment : payment attempts ▶
Payment .right.> PaymentMethod : <<use>>\nmethod
Payment .down.> PaymentStatus : <<use>>\nstatus
Order \"1\" -down- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : related to ▶
User \"1\" -down- \"0..*\" LoyaltyTransaction : owns ▼

@enduml",
 "config": null
